header.userPrompt:
Implement GitHub issue #80 in AlexITC/expense-tracker: fix the bank statement Delete button (confirmation, event propagation, and ctrl/cmd+click navigation). Full spec follows.

## Problem

The "Delete" button on a bank statement card (`web/.../pages/bankstatements/BankStatementsPage.scala`) has two issues.

### 1. No confirmation on a destructive, non-reversible action

`handleDelete` (line ~220) calls `deleteBankStatement` immediately on click (button at line ~297). Deleting a statement removes the document, its blob, and all its rows. There is no confirmation step.

It should open a confirm dialog that summarizes what will be deleted, and makes clear that **expenses are not deleted**: they only lose their link to the statement rows (the row to expense FK is `ON DELETE SET NULL`, and `DeleteBankStatementAction` deletes the document which cascades the statement and its rows, leaving the expenses row-less). The dialog should state, concretely:

- the statement being deleted (filename, account, period)
- how many rows will be removed
- how many of those rows are linked to an expense, and that those expenses will survive but become unlinked

Nothing proceeds until the user explicitly confirms.

### 2. Clicking Delete also opens the statement, showing already-deleted data

The card itself is clickable: `mui.Box.onClick` (line ~314) navigates to `/bank-statements/{id}` for reviewable statements. The Delete button's `onClick` does not stop propagation, so the click bubbles up to the card and navigates to the review page at the same moment the statement is being deleted. The review page then renders stale, already-deleted data.

Fix: stop event propagation on the Delete button's click (and on any other per-card action button), so a button click never triggers the card's navigation.

### 3. Ctrl / cmd + click on a statement opens the wrong page

The card's `onClick` (line ~316) does `dom.window.open(reviewPath, "_blank")` for a ctrl/cmd click, where `reviewPath = /bank-statements/{id}`. In practice the new tab lands on the expenses list (the default page) instead of the statement review. A normal left click uses `history.push(reviewPath)` (SPA nav) and works, so this is specific to the full page load of that route in a new tab. It likely shares a root cause with route refreshability (deep links to `/bank-statements/{id}` not resolving on a cold load). Ctrl/cmd + click should open the actual statement review.

## Acceptance

- Clicking Delete opens a confirm dialog with the summary above; cancel leaves everything untouched.
- Confirming deletes the statement and removes its card, with no navigation to the deleted statement.
- Clicking Delete never opens the review page.
- Ctrl/cmd + click on a statement opens that statement's review in a new tab, not the expenses list.

## Notes

- Keep the existing optimistic card removal on success (line ~224).
- The confirm dialog's row and linked-expense counts should come from the statement data already loaded on the page if available; if a count is not already present, fetch it for the dialog rather than guessing.

resultJson.description:
Fix the three problems with bank statement cards on the Bank Statements page (`BankStatementList` in `web/.../pages/bankstatements/BankStatementsPage.scala`), from GitHub issue #80. (1) Clicking "Delete" currently deletes right away. Deleting removes the document, which cascades to the statement and all its rows. The click also bubbles up to the clickable card, which navigates to `/bank-statements/{id}` while the delete is still running, so the review page shows deleted data. (2) There is no confirmation for this permanent action. (3) Ctrl/cmd + click on a card opens a new tab that ends up on the expenses list instead of the statement review.

When done: per-card action buttons never trigger the card's navigation. Delete opens an MUI confirm dialog showing the filename, account and period, how many rows will be removed, and how many of those rows are linked to an expense. The dialog states that those expenses are kept but lose their link to the statement. Nothing is deleted until the user confirms. On confirm, the existing optimistic card removal still happens. Ctrl/cmd + click opens the real statement review in a new tab.

This is a frontend-only change. No API or DB changes are needed, because the backend already keeps expenses: `bank_statement_row.expense_id` and `refund_id` are `ON DELETE SET NULL`, and expenses have no FK to rows. The linked-expense count is not in the list response, so the dialog fetches it with the existing `getBankStatement(id)` call instead of guessing. The ctrl/cmd + click fix must address the real root cause, which still has to be found by reproducing it. No timing hacks.

tasks.title: Stop per-card action buttons from triggering card navigation
tasks.description: In `BankStatementList.component` (`web/src/main/scala/net/wiringbits/components/pages/bankstatements/BankStatementsPage.scala`), change the `onClick` of each button inside a statement card (the "Review" button around line 291 and the "Delete" button around line 297) to call `ev.stopPropagation()` before doing its own action. Follow the pattern in `ExpensesPage.scala:819-822` (`.onClick { ev => ev.stopPropagation(); ... }`). The card `mui.Box.onClick` (around line 314) stays as it is. Delete still calls `handleDelete` directly here; the confirm dialog is a separate task. Do not change the draft cards' Review/Discard buttons, because draft cards are not clickable. Verify with `CI=true sbt Test/compile`. Per testing.md RULE-TE-010, do not add a DOM test for this.

tasks.title: Add a delete confirmation dialog with a row and linked-expense summary
tasks.description:
Replace the immediate delete with a confirm step.

1. Pure logic, in `BankStatementsLogic.scala`: add a function that builds the dialog summary from a `GetBankStatements.Response.BankStatement` and its `List[GetBankStatement.StatementRowData]`. It returns the filename, the account label (`BankStatementList.accountLabelOf`), the period (`periodStart → periodEnd`), the row count, and the number of rows with `expenseId.isDefined`. Return a small case class or a list of lines. The text should say that the N linked expenses are kept but become unlinked from the statement, and that the action cannot be undone. Add cases to `BankStatementsLogicSpec` (`web/src/test/.../bankstatements/`) for: 0 rows; rows with no links; some rows linked to expenses (rows linked only to a refund or only ignored must not be counted as linked expenses); and the singular/plural wording if you add it.

2. Wiring, in `BankStatementList.component`: add state for the pending delete, e.g. `Option[BankStatement]` plus a fetch state (loading / loaded rows / error). The Delete button keeps `ev.stopPropagation()` and opens the dialog instead of deleting. When it opens: if `s.totalRows == 0`, the counts are known (0/0) with no fetch. Otherwise call `ctx.api.client.getBankStatement(s.id)` and count from `statementRows`. While the counts are loading, show a `mui.CircularProgress` and keep the confirm button disabled. If the fetch fails, show the error in the dialog and keep confirm disabled. Never show guessed counts. Build the dialog like `ExpensesPage.deleteDialog` (lines 993-1012): `mui.Dialog(open)(DialogTitle, DialogContent(DialogContentText...), DialogActions(Cancel, Delete .color("error"))).onClose(...).build`. Cancel and onClose clear the pending state. Confirm calls the existing `handleDelete(id)`, which keeps its optimistic `setLocalStmts(_.filterNot(...))` removal on success and `setError` on failure, and then closes the dialog. Render the dialog once, at the top level of the returned `Fragment` (next to the toast), not inside a card: React synthetic events bubble through MUI's portal to React ancestors, so a dialog inside the card Box would trigger the card's navigation.

Verify with `CI=true sbt Test/compile` and `sbt "testOnly *BankStatementsLogicSpec"`.

tasks.title: Make ctrl/cmd + click on a statement card open its review page
tasks.description:
Card `onClick` (around `BankStatementsPage.scala:314-318`) calls `dom.window.open("/bank-statements/{id}", "_blank")` on ctrl/meta click, and the new tab ends up on `/expenses`. Under `AuthState.Authenticated`, landing on `/expenses` means the router saw `/` or an unmatched path. The catch-all `Redirect("/")` then goes to `homeRedirect` → `/expenses` (see `AppRouter.scala:116,134`). First reproduce and find the root cause, then fix it there.

Reproduce with `sbt dev-web` plus the backend, or `docker compose up`. Then run `curl -s -H 'Accept: text/html' http://localhost:8080/bank-statements/<uuid>` and do a real cold load of that URL in the browser.

Things already checked in this exploration, with no cause found yet:
- `index.html` has `<base href="/">`.
- The webpack devServer has `historyApiFallback: true`.
- The nginx config has `try_files ... /index.html`.
- `AppSplash` waits for `currentUser` before rendering `AppRouter`.
- The `/bank-statements/:stmtId` route is `exact` and registered in the Switch.
- `AuthenticatedLayout` uses the same `window.open(item.path)` approach for single-segment paths.

Things to check:
- Whether the bundle or chunks load on a nested path.
- Whether `currentUser` succeeds in the new tab (cookie/session).
- Any redirect from the server or dev proxy.
- Whether the route matches in react-router 5.1.2.

If the cause is in route resolution for nested paths, fix it so deep links like `/bank-statements/{id}` load on a cold page load, which also fixes refresh. If the fix belongs in shared routing or bootstrap code, add a pure or unit test where possible, for example extending `RouterCompatSpec`. Otherwise justify a test per RULE-TE-010, or document the manual verification. Do not add timing workarounds or hacks. If the root cause is outside this repo or cannot be reproduced, stop and report findings instead of guessing.

Verify with `CI=true sbt Test/compile` plus the targeted spec, and confirm manually that a ctrl/cmd + click opens the review page.

resultJson.brief:
## Modules
- `web/` holds the Scala.js + Slinky + MUI 5 frontend (ScalablyTyped facade `com.olvind.mui.muiMaterial.components as mui`) and react-router-dom 5.1.2 (v5 API: `Switch`, `Route`, `Redirect`, `useHistory`, `useParams`).
- `lib/api/shared/` holds the shared Tapir models and `ApiClient`.
- `server/` is the Play backend. No backend change is needed for this issue.

## Key files
- `web/src/main/scala/net/wiringbits/components/pages/bankstatements/BankStatementsPage.scala`:
  - `BankStatementsPage` wraps `AsyncComponent` around `BankStatementList`.
  - `BankStatementList.component` holds all state and renders the page.
  - Helpers: `accountKeyOf`, `accountLabelOf(s)` ("BBVA (Credit) ••••1234"), `metadataLine(s)`.
  - `handleDelete(id)` (line ~220): `ctx.api.client.deleteBankStatement(id).onComplete { Success => setLocalStmts(_.filterNot(_.id == id)); Failure => setError(ex.getMessage) }`. Keep this optimistic removal.
  - Cards (lines ~234-321): each card is a `mui.Box.sx(cardSx).onClick(e => if isReviewable { if (e.ctrlKey||e.metaKey) dom.window.open(reviewPath,"_blank") else history.push(reviewPath) })(content).withKey(id)`. `isReviewable` means `documentStatus == DocumentStatus.Parsed`.
  - The action buttons sit inside `content`: Review (Parsed only) uses `history.push`, and Delete.
  - The page returns a top-level `Fragment(...)` that ends with the toast Snackbar. Put dialogs there.
- `web/src/main/scala/net/wiringbits/components/pages/bankstatements/BankStatementsLogic.scala`: pure, no React or MUI. Put new pure helpers here. Its test is `web/src/test/scala/net/wiringbits/components/pages/bankstatements/BankStatementsLogicSpec.scala`. `BankStatementListSpec.scala` in the same folder has a `stmt(...)` builder to copy.
- `web/src/main/scala/net/wiringbits/components/pages/expenses/ExpensesPage.scala`:
  - Reference confirm dialog at lines 993-1012: `mui.Dialog(open)(mui.DialogTitle(..), mui.DialogContent(mui.DialogContentText(..)), mui.DialogActions(mui.Button.normal()("Cancel").onClick(..), mui.Button.normal()("Delete").color("error").onClick(..))).onClose((_, _) => ..).build`.
  - Reference stopPropagation at lines 819-822: `.onClick { ev => ev.stopPropagation(); ... }`.
- `web/src/main/scala/net/wiringbits/AppRouter.scala`:
  - `authRoute(path)` is `Route(path, exact = true)(AuthenticatedLayout(...))`.
  - The Authenticated `Switch` lists, in order: `homeRedirect` (`/` → `/expenses`), …, `bankStatementAutoReconcile`, `bankStatementReview` (`/bank-statements/:stmtId`), `bankStatementDraftReview`, `bankStatements`, …, and `catchAllRoute = Route("*")(Redirect("/"))`.
- Bootstrap: `App.scala` (`BrowserRouter(basename = "")` → `AppSplash` → `AppRouter`). `AppSplash.scala` blocks rendering until `api.client.currentUser` completes and then calls `ctx.loggedIn`. `Main.scala` starts `$auth` as `Unauthenticated`. `core/ReactiveHooks.useDistinctValue` seeds its state from `Var()`.
- Serving:
  - `web/src/main/js/index.html` has `<base href="/">` and loads `wiringbits-web-fastopt-bundle.js` by relative path.
  - `custom.webpack.config.js` sets devServer `historyApiFallback: true` and proxies `/api` to the backend.
  - Prod nginx is `infra/config/nginx/web_app_site.j2` (`try_files $uri $uri/ /index.html`).
  - `API.scala` uses an absolute `BuildInfo.apiUrl`, defaulting to `http://localhost:8080/api`.
- `web/src/main/scala/net/wiringbits/components/widgets/AuthenticatedLayout.scala:144` uses the same ctrl/meta + `window.open(item.path)` approach for sidebar items.

## API and models
- `ctx.api.client.getBankStatement(id: UUID): Future[GetBankStatement.Response]`. The response has `statementRows: List[GetBankStatement.StatementRowData]`. Each row has `expenseId: Option[UUID]`, `refundId: Option[UUID]` and `ignoredAt: Option[Instant]`.
- `GetBankStatements.Response.BankStatement` (list item) has: id, documentFilename, documentStatus, bankName, productType, currency, accountLast4, periodStart/periodEnd (`LocalDate`), createdAt, `totalRows: Int`, and `processedRows: Int`. `processedRows` counts rows linked to an expense or refund, or ignored, so it is NOT the linked-expense count.
- `ctx.api.client.deleteBankStatement(id)` calls `DeleteBankStatementAction`, which deletes the document. FK cascade: document → bank_statement → bank_statement_row. `bank_statement_row.expense_id` and `refund_id` are `ON DELETE SET NULL` (evolutions/default/3.sql:204-206). Expenses and refunds survive.

## Conventions
- Get the ExecutionContext with `implicit val ec = props.ctx.executionContext`. Use `Hooks.useState`, and use `SafeHooks.useEffect` for effects.
- Style with `.sx(new CSSPropertiesUtils { ... })` and CSS vars such as `var(--lc-error)` and `var(--lc-text-2)`.
- A React element used more than once in a render tree must be a `def`, not a `val`. Object-level `val`s may contain only plain JS literals.
- MUI Dialog renders in a portal, but React synthetic events still bubble to React ancestors. Render dialogs outside any clickable card Box.
- No silent defaults or guessed data. Show counts only after they are known; while loading or on error, disable confirm.
- No hacks such as `setTimeout` for event ordering.
- Tests use ScalaTest `AnyWordSpec` with `org.scalatest.matchers.must.Matchers.*`.
- Prefer pure-function tests. DOM/jsdom tests need a justification comment (testing.md RULE-TE-010). If you write one, wrap it in `BrowserRouter`; `null.asInstanceOf[API]` is allowed only if the component never calls `ctx.api`.
- Verify with `CI=true sbt Test/compile` (this enables -Werror) and `sbt "testOnly *BankStatementsLogicSpec"`. Do not run the full `sbt test`.
- Web tests need Node 24 on PATH (`nvm use`). Set `NODE_OPTIONS=--openssl-legacy-provider` when running web tests.
- Run `sbt scalafmtAll scalafmtSbt` before committing.
- Run the app locally with `sbt server/run` + `sbt dev-web` (frontend on :8080), or `docker compose up`.
